format: snarkjs ptau (sections 1-7; we consume sections 1-3 only)
source_mirror: PSE (Privacy & Scaling Explorations) AWS S3, eu-central-1
notes: Anyone can re-derive the sha256 via verification_command above.
The .ptau format is SnarkJS-style binary with 7 sections; the WP-M1b.2 PHASE 2 parser consumes sections 1 (header), 2 (tauG1), and 3 (tauG2) only.
Trust model: 1-of-N — one honest contributor among 86 suffices for the SRS to be cryptographically safe.
